name: software_bug_glitch
description: The customer reports unexpected software behavior, a UI glitch, app crash, or a specific bug (e.g. the iOS 11 'I' autocorrect glitch, apps closing unexpectedly, keyboard/text-input defects) not primarily about performance or connectivity.

name: performance_battery
description: Complaints about the device or OS being slow/laggy, freezing, or about battery drain/battery life, typically attributed to a recent iOS/app update.

name: update_installation_issue
description: Problems specifically with installing, downloading, or being prompted about an iOS or app update/version (stuck installs, update won't download, confusion about which version to install).

name: connectivity_hardware_issue
description: WiFi/Bluetooth/cellular connectivity problems, or a physical hardware malfunction (screen, Touch ID/Face ID, water damage, speaker, camera).

name: account_purchase_billing
description: Apple ID/account access issues, in-app purchase or subscription charges, refund requests, App Store/Apple Music/iCloud billing questions, or suspected fraudulent/spam charges.

name: repair_warranty_request
description: The customer wants a physical repair, hardware replacement, or warranty service, or is asking to move to a private channel (DM/phone) for account-specific help.

name: general_inquiry_other
description: How-to questions, feature/compatibility questions, or any message that doesn't clearly report a problem, purchase issue, or repair request — includes general feedback/thanks.
